What We Do

Three disciplines. One advisor.

Most agencies specialize in one. Peachtree was built so your Medicare coverage, life insurance, and long-term savings are planned together — because in practice, they rarely stand alone.

Medicare

Best for: turning 65, losing employer coverage, or unhappy with your current plan

Guidance through Advantage, Supplement, Special Needs, and Prescription Drug plans — matched to the doctors and prescriptions you already rely on.

  • Free annual plan reviews — carriers change formularies and networks every year
  • Honest comparisons across Advantage and Supplement, not a push toward one
  • Ongoing support with claims, ID cards, and provider questions after enrollment
Medicare Advantage Medicare Supplement Special Needs Plan Prescription Drug

Life Insurance

Best for: new parents, homeowners, or covering final expenses so family isn’t left with the bill

Term and final expense coverage sized to protect the people who depend on you — with underwriting handled from first call to policy issue.

  • No-medical-exam options available on most final expense policies
  • Coverage amounts from a few thousand dollars up to seven figures
  • Beneficiary changes and policy reviews handled at no cost, any time
Term Life Final Expense

Wealth & Annuities

Best for: retirees and near-retirees who want protected, predictable income

Fixed indexed and multi-year guaranteed annuities built to convert savings into steady, protected income for retirement.

  • Principal protection — indexed annuities can’t lose value to a market downturn
  • Guaranteed lifetime income riders available on select carriers
  • Side-by-side comparisons of surrender periods and fees across carriers
Fixed Indexed Annuity Multi-Year Guaranteed Annuity

Our Approach

Built like a firm, not a call center.

Every relationship starts with a conversation about your coverage and your budget — never a scripted pitch for a single product.

01

A conversation first, not a quote

We start by understanding your current coverage, budget, and health needs before recommending anything.

02

Independent, carrier-agnostic advice

As an independent agency, we compare across most major carriers rather than representing just one.

03

Support that continues after enrollment

Plans change every year. We review your coverage annually and are reachable when questions come up.

04

One advisor, your whole plan

Medicare, life insurance, and retirement income are handled by the same team — so nothing falls between the cracks.
